title: AWS Overview
description: The AWS services ObserveCraft collects from CloudWatch: EC2, RDS, load balancers, Lambda, S3 and EBS.

definition.content: A starting point for the AWS services ObserveCraft collects from CloudWatch. Add accounts, regions and services in [Integrations → Amazon Web Services](/integrations/aws); every chart filters by account and region.

definition.title: AWS logs
definition.query: source:(cloudwatch OR lambda OR elb OR s3 OR rds OR cloudtrail OR vpc)

definition.content: Instances, their CPU and network. Consistently high CPU is normal for some workloads; maxed-out CPU or failed status checks need a look.
Database instances: connections, CPU, storage and latency.
Classic Load Balancers (ELB) and Application Load Balancers (ALB): healthy hosts, traffic, errors and response time.
Functions: invocations, errors, duration and throttles.
Buckets: size and objects (daily storage metrics) and requests (with request metrics enabled on the bucket).
Volumes: operations, throughput, queue length and burst credits.
